name: END_{speed}_MMS_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. RM4-SA12A 600 x 600 multi-message-frame module (1:10 sheet, 2024): black border 25, no white edge, square corners. END 120 E top 40 (baseline 160), ink 311 (145/311/144). Black ring centred (300, 370): outer R180 (370 + 180 + 50 = 600), inner R155 (ring 25). Speed numerals 160 C ('varies'; the sheet says Series C for these two-numeral values, so C is used rather than the R4-1 rule's D), vertical band 160-450 -> top 290, centred. Values drawn on the sheet: 25, 40, 60 (60 shown in the ring). White class 400. Multi-message frames only. Width check: END 120 E is 340 in the FHWA Series E font; the sheet states 311 and draws it about 308 (E 82, N 89, D 87 wide, gaps 21 / 28 — neither Series D (287) nor E). Kept as the sheet's 311, generated in E at 340, still centred.
